attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Entry point for poker AI decision. Dispatches to the appropriate archetype decision table based on player's archetype setting.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: add new decision entity to context of this table; set decision.player_id = player.id; set decision.archetype = player.archetype; add "Evaluating decision for " + player.name + " (" + player.archetype + ") with hand strength " + player.hand_strength to game.audit_trail;
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: /decision createentity entitypush player.id cvs /decision.player_id xdef player.archetype cvs /decision.archetype xdef "Evaluating decision for " player.name strconcat " (" strconcat player.archetype strconcat ") with hand strength " strconcat player.hand_strength strconcat game.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: TAG (Tight-Aggressive) decision logic. Plays premium hands aggressively, folds weak hands but bets/raises when in a pot. VPIP ~18%.

action_details.action_postfix: { "RAISE" cvs /decision.action xdef game.big_blind 3 fmul cvd /decision.raise_amount xdef "TAG: Strong hand, RAISE 3x BB" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef } {} player.hand_strength 0.70 f>= ifelse { "CALL" cvs /decision.action xdef "TAG: Medium hand with good pot odds, CALL" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef } {} decision.action isnull { pop player.hand_strength 0.50 f>= } over if { pop player.pot_odds player.hand_strength 0.8 fmul f< } over if ifelse { "CHECK" cvs /decision.action xdef "TAG: Medium hand, poor odds, CHECK" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef } {} decision.action isnull { pop player.hand_strength 0.50 f>= } over if { pop player.can_check } over if ifelse { "CHECK" cvs /decision.action xdef "TAG: Weak hand, CHECK for free card" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef } {} decision.action isnull { pop player.hand_strength 0.50 f< } over if { pop player.can_check } over if ifelse { "FOLD" cvs /decision.action xdef "TAG: Default FOLD" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef } {} decision.action isnull ifelse

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: LAG (Loose-Aggressive) decision logic. Plays many hands, applies pressure with bets and raises. Uses position to bluff. VPIP ~35%.

condition_details.condition_dsl: player.position is equal to "late" or player.position is equal to "button"
condition_details.condition_postfix: player.position "late" streq { pop player.position "button" streq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: RAISE - Strong hand or position play
action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "RAISE"; set decision.raise_amount = game.big_blind * 2.5; set decision.reasoning = "LAG: Hand >= 50% or good position with >= 25%, RAISE";
action_details.action_postfix: "RAISE" cvs /decision.action xdef game.big_blind 2.5 fmul cvd /decision.raise_amount xdef "LAG: Hand >= 50% or good position with >= 25%, RAISE" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "CHECK"; set decision.reasoning = "LAG: Weak hand in position, CHECK for free card";
action_details.action_postfix: "CHECK" cvs /decision.action xdef "LAG: Weak hand in position, CHECK for free card" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_comment: CALL - Marginal hand out of position
action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "CALL"; set decision.reasoning = "LAG: Marginal hand (>= 25%) out of position, CALL";
action_details.action_postfix: "CALL" cvs /decision.action xdef "LAG: Marginal hand (>= 25%) out of position, CALL" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "FOLD"; set decision.reasoning = "LAG: Weak hand (less than 25%) out of position, FOLD";
action_details.action_postfix: "FOLD" cvs /decision.action xdef "LAG: Weak hand (less than 25%) out of position, FOLD" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Rock (Tight-Passive) decision logic. Only plays very strong hands. Rarely raises, prefers to call. Very predictable. VPIP ~12%.

action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "RAISE"; set decision.raise_amount = game.big_blind * 2; set decision.reasoning = "Rock: Monster hand (>= 85%), RAISE (rare for Rock)";
action_details.action_postfix: "RAISE" cvs /decision.action xdef game.big_blind 2 fmul cvd /decision.raise_amount xdef "Rock: Monster hand (>= 85%), RAISE (rare for Rock)" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_comment: CALL - Strong hand, play it safe
action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "CALL"; set decision.reasoning = "Rock: Strong hand (60-85%), CALL to see the showdown";
action_details.action_postfix: "CALL" cvs /decision.action xdef "Rock: Strong hand (60-85%), CALL to see the showdown" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "CHECK"; set decision.reasoning = "Rock: Weak hand (less than 60%), CHECK for free card";
action_details.action_postfix: "CHECK" cvs /decision.action xdef "Rock: Weak hand (less than 60%), CHECK for free card" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "FOLD"; set decision.reasoning = "Rock: Weak hand (less than 60%) facing a bet, FOLD";
action_details.action_postfix: "FOLD" cvs /decision.action xdef "Rock: Weak hand (less than 60%) facing a bet, FOLD" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calling Station decision logic. Calls frequently with weak hands. Rarely folds or raises. Easy to value bet against. VPIP ~40%.

condition_details.condition_comment: Bet is small (2x big blind or less)

action_details.action_comment: CALL - Any hand with some value
action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "CALL"; set decision.reasoning = "Calling Station: Any hand >= 20%, CALL (love to see showdowns)";
action_details.action_postfix: "CALL" cvs /decision.action xdef "Calling Station: Any hand >= 20%, CALL (love to see showdowns)" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_comment: CALL - Small bet is worth calling
action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "CALL"; set decision.reasoning = "Calling Station: Small bet, CALL (too cheap to fold)";
action_details.action_postfix: "CALL" cvs /decision.action xdef "Calling Station: Small bet, CALL (too cheap to fold)" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "CHECK"; set decision.reasoning = "Calling Station: Weak hand but can check, CHECK";
action_details.action_postfix: "CHECK" cvs /decision.action xdef "Calling Station: Weak hand but can check, CHECK" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

action_details.action_comment: FOLD - Very weak with big bet
action_details.action_dsl: set decision.action = "FOLD"; set decision.reasoning = "Calling Station: Very weak hand (less than 20%) with large bet, FOLD (reluctantly)";
action_details.action_postfix: "FOLD" cvs /decision.action xdef "Calling Station: Very weak hand (less than 20%) with large bet, FOLD (reluctantly)" cvs /decision.reasoning xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Always, for every player in the game

action_details.action_comment: Decide this player's action using their archetype's table
